findings: Both causal-account commits precede the immutable implementation: 221a283725b265e67e1fffa513f8a227b052536a adds the Cuca export envelope, and e2caf612749cfb03badc7f64bb2f6b4be0cd91eb corrects the final integerization invariant before 1b75e7289a8d9db4a5ab9b2c43e0a7fc5da38e3c. The implementation does not edit either account or any prior checker record.

Pinned Java source supports the amended model. SvekResult.calculateDimension paints the full SVEK result through LimitFinder, moves every solved object by 6-minX and 6-minY, and returns painted span plus 15. LimitFinder applies primitive-specific bounds, including one-pixel rectangle expansion, complete retracted DotPath controls, ten horizontal pixels around polygons, and measured text boxes. CucaDiagram adds five pixels only on the positive axes. SvgGraphics.ensureVisible integerizes a new positive maximum exactly once with (int)(value+1). ExtremityArrow retains its polygon at the contact point while exposing a six-pixel decoration length for path retraction.

The Rust diff builds one eligible flat-graph painted envelope from quantized node positions, transition-to-layout-edge identities, retracted paths, arrow polygons, and complete composed label boxes. Its final dimension helper uses trunc(span+20+1), which matches Java's single positive-maximum integerization including the special already-integral case. Every new parity constant and branch has an adjacent Java provenance comment. Static inspection found no golden reads, fixture labels, source-path switches, per-count ladders, coordinate-keyed SVG surgery, or unexplained high-precision constants.

Seven of eight state-flat-svek-painted-envelope perturbations pass at exact 1b75e728. The fresh reverse cycle proves that backward decoration, four cardinal directions, control-point extrema, and narrow/wide fractional text widths retain exact canvas and painter coordinates. The coloured-stereotype fanout and multi-description styled-link graph show that the activation gate does not overreach for those admitted flat shapes and per-entity or per-link styles. The reordered distinct-route pseudostate graph proves exact choice, history, deep-history, fork, join, named-final, source-order, and label bounds when each transition has a distinct route identity.

The fresh checker_reordered_pseudostate_mesh pair fails. Java and Rust both produce the exact 654x438 canvas and matching nodes, pseudostates, origins, and dimensions. Only the two independently labelled SplitCobalt3239-to-MergeIndigo3271 routes are exchanged: Rust assigns the right path to upper_branch and the left path to lower_branch_with_width, while Java assigns them oppositely. The polygons and label x positions move with those exchanged paths. This is the account's explicitly excluded same-endpoint transition-to-layout-edge identity mechanism, not a painted-envelope arithmetic error, but the valid failing checker input must remain preserved and keeps the executable perturbation gate red.

The distinct-route control uses the same reordered pseudostates, labels, and primitive set but inserts separate upper and lower relay endpoints; it passes exactly. This isolates the checker failure to parallel same-endpoint route association rather than a missing node, text, polygon, arrowhead, dimension, or source-order painter.

The exact immutable snapshot passes all 694 rustuml-render release unit tests and workspace release clippy with warnings denied. The no-oracle census passes its ratchet at 11049/11251 eligible pairs, including state 882/901, rendering 79/98, and type-detection 41/42.

The aggregate perturbation test fails at exact 1b75e728 with the checker files present. For this mechanism it reports checker_reordered_pseudostate_mesh; it also reports the already-preserved rejected state-arrow-style-isolation alias case and two state-recursive-group-simplification cases. The other seven envelope pairs are absent from the failure list and pass.

The individual mechanical guards pass: no_golden_data_embedded_in_shipping_crates, error_golden_census_is_frozen, decimal_literal_ratchet, comparator_constants_frozen, and parity_review_paths_reject_traversal. With this review copied into the exact snapshot, the aggregate guard passes those five tests and fails only parity_review_records_are_complete because this and other latest records are rejected; it reports no malformed schema, missing pair, unnamed perturbation, path traversal, or frozen-baseline violation. No comparator, syntax-error census, park list, baseline guard, or review allow-list was weakened.

The immutable implementation fails cargo fmt --check at crates/rustuml-render/src/state.rs:6098 because the new body_width call is split contrary to rustfmt. This is independently sufficient to keep the repository standing-invariants gate red, although it does not affect rendering semantics.

Verdict is rejected. The envelope derivation itself is strongly supported, but the review gate does not permit accepting an immutable commit with a fresh valid failing heldout or a broken standing invariant. A correction should format the implementation and fix transition-to-layout-edge ownership for parallel same-endpoint labelled links without changing the proven painted-envelope constants or activation domain, then request a new independent review that preserves all eight pairs.
